elaine: Swarm: POC is seeing 403 on /v1/generate mid-demo. They say it worked yesterday. Can someone help triage?

tom: Ask for the exact request and response body. 403 payload is usually org/project mismatch or missing scope.

elaine: They pasted this curl (key redacted): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-zzz' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: corp-acme' -d '{"model":"redwood-rl2","input":"hi"}'
Response: {"error":"forbidden","message":"org mismatch: token_org=corp-staging, header_org=corp-acme"}

ajay: Logs confirm token bound to corp-staging. Header doesn't override binding. Tell them to run /v1/whoami to confirm token binding.

elaine: Sent them this: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-zzz' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami
Sample response we provided: {"org":"corp-staging","project":"demo-1","scopes":["generate","embeddings"]}

ajay: Also note: if scopes lack `generate`, POST will 403. If their runner retried on 403/401, they may have hit 429s. auth-bot: alert: 429 quota_burst for corp-acme - retry-after 18s

elaine: Recommended steps to customer: 1) pause test runner; 2) run whoami and confirm token binding; 3) either remove X-Redwood-Org header or use a token for corp-acme; 4) request a short-lived POC token if needed.

tom: Sales-ops: can we approve a temp token for their demo (200k tokens, 7 days, 200 RPM)?

sales-ops: Approved if AE notes it in deal memo.

ajay: I'll draft the security one-pager: token binding semantics, whoami example, sample log lines, audit retention (90d for POC), and recommended scope combos. ETA EOD.

elaine: Customer swapped to the temp token we issued and re-ran slowly; 403s cleared and only a couple of transient 429s. Closing unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
